title: Vertical conductors and leaders.
officialText:
Vertical conductors and leaders shall be sized for the maximum projected roof area, in accordance with Tables 1106.2(1) and 1106.2(2).

SIZE OF CIRCULAR VERTICAL CONDUCTORS AND LEADERS

sectional shape fully encloses a circle of the diameter indicated in this table. For rectangular leaders, see Table 1106.2(2). Interpolation is permitted for pipe sizes that fall between those listed in this table. SIZE OF RECTANGULAR VERTICAL CONDUCTORS AND LEADERS

using the data from Table 1106.2(1).

D = [width × length]1/2 (Equation 11-1) e

where:

D = equivalent circular diameter and D , width and length are in inches. e e
